lede: Thanksgiving lands square in the middle of this week, and the valley is leaning into it — Turkey Trot on Thursday morning, an Outlaw Thanksgiving dinner at Alloy Kitchen, and live music through the holiday weekend including Will Ski 4 Food on the mountain Saturday and Sunday. On the government side, both the Board of County Commissioners Work Session and the Mountain Village Metro District meeting are on the calendar, but neither has posted an agenda yet, so there's nothing to track down or weigh in on this week.
